charts.description: Shows the total revenue generated by each product category.
charts.sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.total_price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
charts.title: Revenue by Category

charts.description: Tracks the number of orders placed over a specific period.
charts.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', order_date) AS order_date, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', order_date) ORDER BY order_date ASC
charts.title: Orders Over Time

primary_kpis.description: The total revenue generated from all completed orders.
primary_kpis.name: Total Revenue
primary_kpis.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'DELIVERED' OR order_status = 'COMPLETED'

primary_kpis.description: The average amount spent per order.
primary_kpis.name: Average Order Value
primary_kpis.sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'DELIVERED' OR order_status = 'COMPLETED'
